site.name: Jimtown Mining Company Mine
site.componentDetail: Historic underground uranium mine recorded as Jimtown Mining Co; federal mineral records classify it as a past producer
overview: Jimtown Mining Company Mine is a documented historic uranium mine in Boulder County's Jamestown Mining District. Federal mineral-record data identifies the property as Jimtown Mining Co and classifies it as an underground past producer.
The recorded site point lies near Jamestown at roughly 6,998 feet elevation. It is a database identification point, not a field-surveyed surviving shaft or portal.
The available record does not document production totals, ownership or the condition of the workings. Visitors should respect private property, closures and posted restrictions.

timeline.text: A Colorado Bureau of Mines listing cited by the federal mineral record documented the Jimtown Mining Co property.
The Mineral Resources Data System classified Jimtown Mining Co as a past-producing underground uranium mine in Boulder County.

moreHistory: The surviving desk record is concise but site-specific: it identifies uranium as the primary commodity and records an underground operation rather than a district-only locality.
No verified production years, ownership sequence or surviving-feature survey was found in the accessible sources reviewed for this rebuild.
The mapped point should be used for historical identification only and does not establish public access or a safe route to mine workings.
